buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bidders has to go through all the specification of bid and quote rate accordingly. 2. Bidders has to submit the self-certified undertaking on their letter head accepting all the terms and con ditions of the bid. 3.Bidders are to submit the past experience relevant to the services as per the bid. Text Clause(s) (a) The service provider will be given notice 12 hrs during peace time in advance for positioning of the req uired transport on telephone call/Mail whereas, vendor have to provide the services as soon as possible du ring the insurgency/urgency/emergency situations. If the transporter is unable to position the same within t he specified place, buyer will be at liberty to arrange truck at the risk and expense of the original con tractor.

(b) Vehicle should have all valid documents like registration certificate, insurance, pollution certificate etc. The vehicles should be registered with concerned authorities of central/ state government. The drive rs must follow traffic rules and other regulations prescribed by the government from time to time. (c) Vehicle should have valid permit for operating between start location to drop location. (d) Driver should be 18 years or above and should possess valid driving license for commercial vehicles/ h eavy vehicles as applicable. (e) In the case of any accident/ violation of traffic rules, all the claims arising out of it shall be met bythe co ntractor. (f) If any particular vehicle goes out of order, the contractor shall provide a substitute vehicle of same type /equivalent class of vehicles immediately. In case the substitute vehicle does not report on time/d oes not report at all, the IAF would have a right to hire a vehicle from the market & the additional cost incu rred b y the IAF will be borne by the contractor. (g) All necessary accessories for loading i.e. tarpaulin, chains, ropes, etc. required for fastening and lashin g of equipments must be supplied by the service provider along with the vehicles. (h) Fire extinguisher should be available in driver’s cabin of each vehicle. (i) A self declaration certificate by the service provider for accepting all the above mentioned terms and co nditions should be uploaded by the bidders at the time of bidding. . 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider
